bead.description: Top reliability invariant (root cause of the weeks of stalls): unavailable/stale/local provider = clean skip, never no_viable when a subscription harness is dispatchable. See docs/helix/01-frame/features/FEAT-004-model-routing.md 'Addendum: tiered, quota-aware routing' for the normative model + failure-classification table.
bead.acceptance: 1. Test: all local/HTTP down + claude/codex available -> ResolveRoute returns subscription candidate (not no_viable). 2. stale/missing snapshot doesn't block. 3. go test ./internal/routing/... . green. 4. lefthook passes.
